gold.taskTitle: Plan a Mother-Daughter Spa Day Together
gold.taskDescription: Organize a relaxing and enjoyable spa day experience specifically for a mother and daughter.

questions.title: What is your target date for the spa day?
questions.description: Identify the specific date or timeframe the user has in mind.

questions.title: What is your approximate budget for this outing?
questions.description: Determine the total amount the user is willing to spend.

questions.title: Will you go to a spa or create one at home?
questions.description: Clarify whether the spa day is at a professional facility or a DIY home setup.

questions.title: What city or area should the spa be located in?
questions.description: Get the geographic location to help narrow down venue options.

questions.title: What specific treatments are you hoping to include?
questions.description: Find out which services matter most, such as massages, facials, or manicures.

questions.title: Are there any health conditions or allergies to consider?
questions.description: Identify any physical limitations or sensitivities that could affect treatment choices.

questions.title: Is this tied to a special occasion or celebration?
questions.description: Determine if the event marks a birthday, holiday, or other milestone, which may shape the planning.
